notes: Registers the failure aborting extension from reject-junit5-exception-handler-aborts-failures for every test through the ServiceLoader file and turns on JUnit 5 extension autodetection, without touching any test class. Both files are new and hand written, built on the real extension's class name; I did not check whether the project already has these files, so the paths are illustrative. Rejected by the path validator (test runner configuration) and by the checker's content rules.
